name: brooding_octopus
description: Deep-sea brooding octopus (Graneledone boreopacifica), facing right: pale purplish-grey #9c8aa6 warty body draped over a cluster of white teardrop eggs attached to a grey rock ledge, saggy mantle up-left (top ~y -360), arms wrapped around the cluster down to the ledge, one small open eye with a bar pupil under a heavy lid at (130,-268). Thin and still, not sickly. Anchor bottom-centre = ledge top (rock below to y +52); ~x -310..310, y -360..52.
